categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文一半在拆解模型内部表征与数据归因的可解释性问题，一半把生成建模、安全对齐和Agent能力往真实场景里推。

articles.title: Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
articles.zh: 厘清语言模型数据归因的设计空间
articles.summary: 如果你要判断模型输出到底该"归功"于哪批训练数据，这篇把各种归因方法的取舍维度摊开讲清楚了，选方案前值得先看一眼
articles.author: Steven Yu, Sheng-Yu Wang 等
articles.body: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark. The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.
articles.bodyZh: 语言模型（Language Models, LMs）的数据归因方法（Data attribution methods），通常靠事实检索（fact retrieval）这类下游任务（downstream tasks）来评估。但现有评估会同时改动数据集的多个属性，导致我们没法单独定位一个归因算法到底为什么失败。为了诊断这些失败，我们梳理了大语言模型（LLM）数据归因的设计空间，重点放在评估上。我们提出了一个用于事实追踪（fact tracing）的可控归因基准（Controlled Attribution Benchmark, CATT）：让大语言模型只在完全虚构的知识上微调，这样归因就有了明确无误的真值（ground truth）。这个合成设置（synthetic setup）让我们能一次只改一个数据集配置（dataset configuration），比如文档冗余（document redundancy）和词汇干扰项（lexical distractors）。用这种可配置的评估，我们证明冗余和干扰项会稳定地拉低归因表现。我们没有提出新的估计器（estimator），而是检查了两个之前没怎么被研究的设计选择：计算梯度（gradients）时用哪个损失函数（loss），以及怎么把每个 token 的归因分数（per-token attribution scores）聚合成文档分数（document score）。我们发现，训练文档里真正的因果证据（causal evidence）其实高度局部化，但标准方法把整篇文档的归因分数一平均，就把这些证据稀释成噪声了。我们还发现，把标准的交叉熵损失梯度（cross-entropy loss gradients）换成负对数几率梯度（negative log-odds gradients），能让关键 token 从其他没信息的 token 里凸显出来。然后只聚合分数最高的那些 token，就能在我们的诊断基准（diagnostic benchmark）上，让多个基线方法（baselines）的真值召回率（ground truth recall）提高 35 到 72 个百分点。这个负对数几率修正还能推广到 FTRACE-TREX，让我们测试的每一种方法在反事实重训练（counterfactual retraining）上的表现都变好，最高提升到 4.9 倍。

articles.title: Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
articles.zh: 重新审视无需权重扰动的神经"丛林"（thickets）现象
articles.summary: 如果你默认模型集成效果靠的是权重加噪，这篇提醒你"丛林"可能另有成因，做集成和鲁棒性实验的得重新校准假设
articles.author: Nicolas Dufour, Elouan Gardès 等
articles.body: The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover. We reproduce the reported gains, but show that they do not require this geometric explanation. Perturbing a single decoder block already recovers much of the improvement, while keeping the model entirely frozen and adding a random bias to its output logits matches or exceeds full-weight perturbations on most reasoning tasks. This suggests an alternative explanation based on output diversity, validation-based selection, and voting. We formalize this view as Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV), a general procedure that generates perturbed predictors, selects high-performing members on a small validation set, and aggregates their predictions. This interpretation connects Neural Thickets to established inference-time methods, including sampling, self-consistency, and verifier-guided selection. A first-order analysis further shows that small weight perturbations act primarily through their induced logit shifts. We extend this analysis to vision, where logit PSV substantially improves performance under domain shift, including on Earth observation, while full-weight perturbations provide little additional benefit. Together, these results suggest that the gains attributed to nearby weight-space experts can instead be obtained through output diversity, selection, and voting. Logit PSV realizes these benefits with a fully frozen model, providing a simple, training-free alternative to full-weight perturbation ensembles across language and vision.
articles.bodyZh: “神经丛林”（Neural Thickets）这个假说认为，预训练语言模型在权重空间里待在一群任务专用专家扎堆的密集区域里，随机高斯扰动就能把这些专家“挖”出来。我们复现了论文里说的提升，但发现这并不需要那套几何解释。只扰动一个解码器块（decoder block），就已经能拿回大部分提升；而如果把模型完全冻住，只在输出 logits 上加一个随机偏置，在大多数推理任务上也能追平甚至超过对全部权重做扰动。这说明更可能的解释是：输出多样性、基于验证集的选择，再加上投票。我们把这个思路正式写成“扰动—选择—投票”（Perturb-Select-Vote, PSV）：先生成一批被扰动过的预测器，再用一个小验证集挑出表现好的成员，最后把它们的预测聚合起来。这个解释把 Neural Thickets 和已有的推理时方法连起来了，比如采样、自洽性（self-consistency）和验证器引导的选择。进一步做个一阶分析还能看到，小的权重扰动主要就是通过它带来的 logit 偏移起作用。我们把这个分析扩展到视觉任务：在领域偏移（domain shift）下，包括对地观测（Earth observation），只对 logit 做 PSV 就能明显提升表现，而扰动全部权重几乎没多出什么好处。总的来说，这些结果说明，原本归功于“附近权重空间专家”的收益，其实可以通过输出多样性、选择和投票拿到。Logit PSV 用一个完全冻结的模型就能实现这些好处，给语言和视觉任务提供了一个简单、免训练（training-free）的替代方案，用来替代全权重扰动集成（full-weight perturbation ensembles）。

articles.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
articles.zh: 读、分配、路由：像素空间生成Transformer中角色耦合的token化方法
articles.summary: 如果你在做像素空间的生成式Transformer，这套把token按角色分工的token化思路可能直接省掉你调感受野的一堆试错
articles.author: Jiongfan Yang, Weichen Fan 等
articles.body: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.
articles.bodyZh: 像素空间的生成式 Transformer（pixel-space generative Transformers）通常是一个图像块（image patch）配一个 token，所以想抓住更细的细节就得多上 token，全局注意力（global attention）也会越来越贵。我们发现，更细的细节不一定需要更多全局通信：低频结构（low-frequency structure）适合全局交换，高频细节（high-frequency detail）在局部建模就行。基于这个观察，我们提出 SpecSlot，一个像素空间的整流流 Transformer（rectified-flow Transformer），它把输出细节和全局注意力序列的长度解耦。SpecSlot 会把每个空间锚点（spatial anchor）扩展成多个槽位（slot），每个槽位分到一段互不重叠的 DCT 系数（DCT coefficients）频段；这样就把锚点密度和频谱细分（spectral subdivision）分开了。每个锚点只有最低频的槽位参与全局注意力，所有槽位则在局部交互。这样一来，模型就能增加频谱细节，又不用把全局序列拉长。还有一个空间头（spatial head），会给频谱预测（spectral prediction）加一个局部修正；而生成状态（generative state）、目标（target）和损失（loss）仍然留在像素空间里。在 ImageNet-256 上，SpecSlot 的最终 FID（Fréchet Inception Distance）跟算力对齐的 JiT 对照组（JiT control）差不多，但收敛更快。在 ImageNet-512 上，它比对照组把 FID 好了 2.84，同时浮点运算量（FLOPs）还少 3.9%；跟 JiT-B/16 相比，FID 差距只有 0.69，成本却低 38.2%。在文生图（text-to-image generation）上，SpecSlot 在 DPG-Bench 上比 JiT-B/8 高 1.06，前向成本（forward cost）还低 40.6%。

articles.title: Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
articles.zh: 行李重识别：面向真实应用场景的策略研究
articles.summary: 如果你想把ReID从论文搬进机场行李追踪，这篇讲的是真实场景里哪些策略能扛住、哪些只是刷榜好看
articles.author: Quentin Dhôte, Romaric Audigier
articles.body: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (lost luggage recovery). It enables the association of observations of the same luggage across disjoint camera views in complex environments such as airports, train stations and border crossing. While existing approaches primarily focus on appearance-based cropped image matching under relatively clean conditions, real-world scenarios are characterized by frequent occlusions, cluttered background and crowded scenes which significantly degrade performance. Yet, strategies leveraging the complementarity of multiple shots and views from different video streams is overlooked. In this paper, we study strategies for an end-to-end pipeline that operates from multiple video streams to detect and re-identify luggage. We evaluate different variants on a benchmark dataset acquired in real-world environments to address the questions of selecting and merging different views and shots of the same luggage as well as training on different environment datasets for an overall ReID performance improvement in practical applications.
articles.bodyZh: 行李重识别（Luggage Re-identification, ReID）在视频监控（video surveillance）里是个关键任务，不管是做取证（forensics）、安保、边境管理（比如识别可疑或被遗落的行李），还是做行李管理（比如找回丢失行李），都用得上。它能让我们在机场、火车站、边境口岸这类复杂环境里，把不同摄像头拍到的同一件行李关联起来。现有方法主要是在相对干净的情况下，拿裁剪出来的图像做基于外观的匹配（appearance-based cropped image matching）；但现实场景里经常有遮挡（occlusions）、背景杂乱（cluttered background）、人群拥挤（crowded scenes），这些都会让效果明显变差。可另一方面，利用不同视频流里多次拍摄和多个视角之间的互补性，这个思路却被忽视了。在这篇论文里，我们研究了一套端到端流程（end-to-end pipeline），从多路视频流出发，做行李检测和重识别。我们在真实环境采集的基准数据集（benchmark dataset）上评估了不同方案，想回答几个问题：怎么选择和融合同一件行李的不同视角、不同次拍摄；以及怎么在不同环境的数据集上训练，从而在实际应用里把重识别的整体效果提上去。

articles.title: From extreme weather to agricultural consequences with agentic AI
articles.zh: 用Agentic AI从极端天气推导农业后果
articles.summary: 如果你关心Agent怎么串起"气象数据→农业影响"这条链，这篇给了一个可参照的任务拆解范式，但别指望它替代领域模型
articles.author: Minghan Yu, Mengyu Dai 等
articles.body: Extreme weather is forecast days ahead, yet its consequences for agriculture remain hard to predict: a forecast says where a storm will strike, not which crops will suffer or how much is at risk, and the records that could tell span many sources. We present WxCrop, the first agent that judges agricultural hazards from physically interpretable weather indices examined by causal analysis, and the first that combines weather and agricultural information to predict crop loss reliably for past and forecast dates. We demonstrate it in Florida on hurricanes, freezes and dry heat, with a loss model calibrated on insurance records for each, and the same procedure extends to other hazards and areas. Three checks show reliability: the hurricane index detects recorded cyclone days with an AUC of 0.98, recorded losses in held-out years are reproduced to within 2%, and independent production records confirm the county rankings (rank correlation 0.63). Users ask the agent for each crop group's loss as a fraction of expected season value, every number sourced, so that governments, growers and scientists respond to agricultural disasters quickly.
articles.bodyZh: 极端天气（extreme weather）提前几天就能预报，但它对农业会造成什么后果，还是很难说准：预报只能告诉你风暴会打在哪儿，却不会告诉你哪些作物会遭殃、风险有多大；而能用来判断的记录又分散在很多来源里。我们推出 WxCrop，这是第一个通过因果分析（causal analysis）来检查物理可解释天气指数（physically interpretable weather indices）、从而评估农业灾害（agricultural hazards）的智能体（agent），也是第一个把天气信息和农业信息结合起来、能对过去日期和预报日期都较可靠地预测作物损失（crop loss）的智能体。我们在佛罗里达州用飓风（hurricanes）、寒潮（freezes）和干热（dry heat）做了演示，每种灾害的损失模型（loss model）都用对应的保险记录（insurance records）校准过，而且同一套流程可以推广到其他灾害和地区。三项检查证明了它的可靠性：飓风指数识别有记录的气旋天数的 AUC（曲线下面积）达到 0.98；在留出年份（held-out years）里，有记录的损失能被复现到误差 2% 以内；独立的生产记录也印证了各县排名（秩相关 rank correlation 为 0.63）。用户可以问这个智能体：每个作物组（crop group）的损失相当于预期当季价值的多大比例，而且每个数字都有出处，这样政府、种植户和科学家就能更快应对农业灾害。

articles.title: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
articles.zh: 探测视觉基础模型中的空间状态表征
articles.summary: 如果你以为视觉基础模型真"懂"三维空间，这篇的探针结果会让你对它们的空间推理能力重新打折
articles.author: Baiqiao Yin, Zhongang Cai 等
articles.body: An observer sees only part of the surrounding world, yet must keep track of what lies beyond the current view. Spatial perception therefore involves more than recognizing individual images: it calls for a persistent spatial state that is updated under self-motion and used to guide action. Do visual foundation models provide representations that support such a state? We study this question through four levels of spatial capability---spatial structure, object persistence, predictive spatial update, and actionability---using frozen-feature probes on ten representations under streaming egocentric observations of static indoor environments. The resulting capability profiles vary across tasks, network layers, and prefix lengths: strong readout of the visible scene does not ensure accurate object persistence or future-feature retrieval. Matched controls separate readout accuracy from reliance on visual history and motion. Native future prediction retains recoverable spatial structure, but a spatial reader trained on real features does not transfer to predicted features unchanged. Finally, goal-dependent candidate selection does not establish reliable continuous action utility: predicted actions respond to goal changes, yet supplying the correct goal does not reliably improve progress. Across the four levels, object persistence and actionability build on camera-pose readout, whereas feature prediction builds on visible-scene readout. Together, these findings motivate evaluating spatial representations not only by what can be decoded from them, but by whether that information is maintained beyond observation, updated predictively, and used for goal-directed action.
articles.bodyZh: 一个观察者只能看到周围世界的一部分，但又必须随时掌握当前视野之外有什么。所以，空间感知不只是认出单张图像，还需要一个持续存在的空间状态（spatial state），在自我运动时不断更新，并用来指导行动。那么，视觉基础模型（visual foundation models）提供的表征（representations），能不能支撑这样一个状态呢？我们围绕四个层级的空间能力来研究这个问题——空间结构（spatial structure）、物体持续性（object persistence）、预测性空间更新（predictive spatial update）和可行动性（actionability）——方法是在静态室内环境里做流式第一视角观察（streaming egocentric observations），对十种表征用冻结特征探针（frozen-feature probes）做测试。得到的能力画像（capability profiles）会随任务、网络层和前缀长度变化：能把可见场景读得很准（readout），并不代表物体持续性或未来特征检索就一定准确。匹配对照（matched controls）把读出准确性和对视觉历史与运动的依赖区分开来。原生未来预测（native future prediction）能保留可恢复的空间结构，但在真实特征上训练出来的空间读取器（spatial reader），不能原样迁移到预测特征上。最后，依赖目标的候选选择（goal-dependent candidate selection）并不能证明有可靠的连续动作效用（continuous action utility）：预测出的动作会随目标变化而变化，可就算给对了目标，也不一定能稳定地提升推进效果。横跨这四个层级看，物体持续性和可行动性建立在相机位姿读出（camera-pose readout）之上，而特征预测建立在可见场景读出（visible-scene readout）之上。综合起来，这些发现提醒我们：评估空间表征（spatial representations）时，不能只看能从里面解码出什么，还要看这些信息能不能在观察结束之后继续保持、能不能被预测性地更新，以及能不能用于目标导向的行动。

articles.title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
articles.zh: ShallowDefend：利用浅层安全对齐构建多轮对话防御
articles.summary: 如果你只给模型做了单轮安全对齐就上线，这篇说明多轮诱导下浅层对齐既是漏洞也是可以反用的防线
articles.author: Qiyao Ma, Xiaodong Liu 等
articles.body: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.
articles.bodyZh: 安全对齐（safety alignment）让大语言模型（large language models）能可靠地直接拒绝有害请求，可同一个请求只要被拆到多轮对话（multi-turn conversation）里，还是常常能得手。这种“脆”有机制上的根源：对齐太浅，安全行为主要集中在模型最开始的几个输出词元（output tokens）上，现有防御也继承了这个毛病——只监督回答的表面形式（surface form），却从没让模型学到一个明确的安全决策。我们对“浅”反过来看：既然一小段内容就能决定整个回答的走向，那这一段就是最值得干预、杠杆最高的地方，防御方完全可以先占住它。我们提出“评估 → 决策 → 回答”（Assess → Decide → Respond）框架：防御方先判断用户意图，先明确给出一个可解析的安全决策（parseable safety decision），然后才根据这个决策生成回复；这个决策承诺要在关键请求轮（payload turn）用强化学习（reinforcement learning）训练出来。因为决策本身就是一段词元片段（token span），所以奖励可以做成一条规则：自验证奖励（self-verified reward）会拿模型承诺的标签，去对照这段对话已知的性质，不需要裁判模型，也不需要人工标注；而同一套格式还支持用大模型当裁判（LLM-as-judge）的奖励，在带安全转向（safe redirection）的分级决策空间（graded decision space）里打分。在两个模型家族、覆盖安全、实用性（utility）和有用性（helpfulness）的十四个基准（benchmarks）上，我们的防御方案在受控对比中拿到了最强的多轮安全性，而且在安全上保持领先的同时，保住了实用性，只付出适度的有用性代价。逐词元 KL 分析（per-token KL analysis）和干预探针（interventional probes）也证实了它为什么管用：训练把效果集中在那段决定回答走向的短暂斟酌上，而在这里做出的决策就是一个因果控制点（causal control point）。攻击者钻的那点“浅”，反倒成了防御的机制。

articles.title: Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses
articles.zh: 来自时间线的证词：基于证据的时间性临床假设显著性检验
articles.summary: 如果你在临床时序数据里找"某因素是否真的影响结局"，这套带证据支撑的显著性检验能帮你少讲几个站不住的故事
articles.author: Chengyang He, Wenlong Zhang 等
articles.body: Ask a language model whether sales tend to dip after a product recall, or whether one side effect tends to follow another after a vaccine, and it answers in a fluent sentence that reads like a finding, with no test behind it. Assertions about how events unfold across many cases fill the Web, and each is a temporal hypothesis that only a significance test over the right records can settle. The verifier must specify the null, select the test and decide which records bear on the hypothesis, and any of these choices can go wrong while the conclusion still comes out right. Yet benchmarks for language-model data analysis grade only the conclusion, with the relevant data handed over. We study the problem in health, where a wrong verdict is costly, and present STRATA, a benchmark that grades every decision on the way to a verdict: 8,735 hypotheses over the clinical timelines of vaccine adverse-event reports, with gold plans, evidence sets, p-values and verdicts derived under a released codebook and reproduced by a deterministic oracle. We also propose ART (articulate, retrieve, test), a staged paradigm that exposes each decision as an inspectable output. Extensive experiments with five model configurations show that systems fail mostly at choosing which records count, a verdict-evidence gap that accuracy alone conceals. ART closes most of this gap and brings a 31B open model to within 0.01 of the frontier models under the same paradigm; the frontier models succeed once given the codebook.
articles.bodyZh: 你问一个语言模型（language model）：产品召回（product recall）之后销量是不是容易下滑？或者接种疫苗之后，一种副作用是不是容易跟着另一种来？它会甩给你一句很顺的话，读起来像个研究结论，可背后根本没做检验。网上到处都有人断言：很多事情在多起案例里是怎么一步步发生的。每一个这种断言，其实都是一个时间性假设（temporal hypothesis），只有拿对记录做显著性检验（significance test），才能定真假。验证者（verifier）得把原假设（null）说清楚、选好检验方法、决定哪些记录跟这个假设有关；这些选择哪一步都可能出错，但最后结论还可能看起来是对的。可现有语言模型数据分析（language-model data analysis）的基准测试（benchmarks），只给结论打分，相关数据还直接送到手上。我们在医疗场景里研究这个问题——这里判错代价很高——并推出 STRATA：一个把通往结论路上的每个决定都打分的基准测试。它包含 8,735 个假设，围绕疫苗不良事件报告（vaccine adverse-event reports）的临床时间线（clinical timelines）；标准方案（gold plans）、证据集（evidence sets）、p值（p-values）和判定（verdicts）都按一份公开的编码手册（codebook）推出来，并由确定性的判定器（deterministic oracle）复现。我们还提出 ART（articulate, retrieve, test）——一套分阶段范式（staged paradigm），把每个决定都暴露成可检查的输出。我们拿五种模型配置（model configurations）做了大量实验，发现系统主要栽在“哪些记录才算数”这一步；这就是一个只靠准确率看不出来的结论-证据差距（verdict-evidence gap）。ART 把这个差距补上了大部分，还让一个 310 亿参数的开源模型（31B open model）在同一范式下，离前沿模型（frontier models）只差 0.01；而前沿模型只要拿到编码手册，就能做对。
